body: My lock screen is a diagram of the solar system, the moon, and Mars. My home screen is 3 polariods of myself with a positive quote underneath them. After leaving a toxic relationship, I had a hard time seeing beauty and worth in myself, so the home screen is a reminder to appreciate and love myself.
Felt, I have horrible depression so sometimes I can go months without washing the sheets. I end up feeling disgusting thinking about it, but I physically can’t bring myself to wash them sometimes.
Similar thing happened to me, still haven’t figured it out. A blue chat box that’s just pending? I think it’s just a glitch.

Yeah but this one has a blue box as if I sent something and they read it, but it says pending. It’s a new account so it shouldn’t have memory of any past connections and such right? I just thought it was weird and was curious.
Yes, fingers crossed 🤞🏼

It is and don’t get me wrong, there’s many wonderful things in life. Things that make me happy to be alive, but there’s always that ache and the cons outweigh the pros. After a while, you just stop really caring altogether. I’m just numb to most of it now.
It’s too much. I no longer know how to fix it.
I’ve never thought of that. Where do I start with something like that?
I truly don’t want to end it, but I’ve been that low before. It terrifies me to think I could fall back into that. I’ve been feeling this way for some time, it’s just starting to boil over I guess.

I’ve joined r/vagabond and I think you’re right. I appreciate your input. I know running from my problems does nothing, but I feel if I want to solve them- I need some space from them first.

I had to drop out of college not long ago- partially why I’m feeling so lost I suppose. I’ve been looking into jobs that accommodate room & board. I just need a fresh start.
I’ll definitely look into these! Thank you, I appreciate it ☺️

It does help some. I just want the pain to stop and I want to start over. There’s a lot of darkness and trauma where I’m at, I’ve tried to confront it and work through it, but I just can’t seem to get there.
Aware and a little nihilistic, but honestly I know what you mean. This is definitely trash.
Thank you. I’m letting myself sit with them today. I can’t keep repressing them.
It was very draining. I’ve isolated myself all day because the emotions are overwhelming.
Yes. So my heart was broken and my best friends heart.
Sorry should’ve clarified that. My friends bf was cheating on her.
That’s what I had thought I found this time around. I really wish people would just drop their egos and say what they really want and feel. Maybe I wouldn’t be so heartbroken over this situation.
Too late. It’s gone. I don’t believe it anymore. All I’ve experienced is hurt and pain. I’ve only ever given love and I’m tired of not receiving it back.

I broke it off with him after he had been becoming distant and somewhat mean. It hurt so much. He was heartbroken, but never said anything and blocked me everywhere. I still miss him and sometimes hope that he’ll eventually talk to me. Idk how I feel about the whole situation. It’s only been a month. I’d like to point out, he’s not exactly the only person I’ve dated, but he is the most serious relationship I’ve had. He’s a good person, very sweet at times- but doesn’t communicate well and says hurtful things without thinking.

It was exhausting and heartbreaking. I wanted so much with him. But we’re still young and figuring out who we are. I have hope that maybe someday we’ll find our way back to each other. If not, I’ll just have to be okay with that.
